**What problem does this solve?**
A real shop-counter problem, not just "it would be nice to have."

**Does this fit the project's scope?**

subscription infrastructure, it's likely out of scope here (see the
`nodedr-restaurant-pos` sister project for larger-scope tooling) — say
here why it still fits a single shop's counter.

What you'd build, at whatever level of detail you have.
